bullets: Run customer engagements start to finish. Take each one from discovery to a live agent to wide use across the team, and own the result.
Represent Nooks to senior leaders. Build credibility with VP- and C-level sales and revenue leaders, and help them plan where agents fit in their org. You’ll also lead executive…
Diagnose, then build. Learn how the customer’s reps and managers actually work, where time and pipeline leak, and how their stack fits together (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach…
Grow usage and impact. Track how agents perform once they’re live, get reps using them, and spot the next workflow worth automating.
Leave a playbook behind. Package what works into templates and frameworks that make the next deployment faster for everyone.
Own Outbound's outcomes. Set the vision, roadmap, and success metrics, and connect them to customer pipeline, growth, and retention.
Partner across GTM. Work with Sales, Marketing, and CS on positioning, product marketing, packaging, consumption pricing, and launches.
Make it easy to sell. Help Sales and Enablement turn new capabilities into a repeatable selling motion as the product scales.
Lead and build the team. Manage the PMs on Outbound and hire as scope grows, while staying hands-on in the highest-stakes calls.
Define agentic outbound. Decide where agents act autonomously, where reps stay in the loop, and how quality, trust, and deliverability are measured.
Lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution for a major product area critical to Nooks’ AI sales platform.
Drive high-impact initiatives that combine cutting-edge AI capabilities with deep understanding of sales workflows.
Partner closely with engineering and design leadership to define ambitious but achievable technical and UX goals.
Engage deeply with customers and data to identify new opportunities for automation, efficiency, and revenue growth.
Communicate product vision and outcomes clearly to executives and the broader organization.
